text: Insurance investigator John Trent, raving in an asylum, tells how a publisher hired him to find the vanished horror writer Sutter Cane. [Cane's book covers form a map|trigger|digging into a mystery] to Hobb's End, New Hampshire, a town that exists only in his novels, and on the drive [the road itself vanishes|rules|reality comes apart]. The town is exactly as written, with an inn, an ancient church and townspeople demanding their missing children, and Cane's new manuscript [drives its readers mad|origin|stories come true].
